recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not revert Encounter.diagnosis.use to 0..1 based on the old rank rationale, because later published Encounter decisions removed that context and deliberately made the element repeating. Do not add old diagnosis-role definitions in core; remaining diagnosis-role terminology work belongs to THO/UTG.
issue_request: FHIR-20484 asked to relax Encounter.diagnosis.use to 0..* because diagnosis use classifications can overlap, clarify the diagnosis-role codes, add quality-measure and billing-related codes, and rename billing to billing diagnosis. Its Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution kept the cardinality unchanged at the time because Encounter.diagnosis.rank was tied to the repeating diagnosis backbone, while requiring diagnosis-role definitions to be completed.
initial_application: No core source commit was found that directly names FHIR-20484, consistent with the final decision not requiring a core cardinality edit in the then-current model. PA minutes record the 2020-02-06 vote. The terminology-definition follow-up was later handled outside the core checkout by UP-529, which lists FHIR-20484 as adding definitions for diagnosis-role and was published in THO 5.5.0.
additional_context: FHIR-16148 later redesigned Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis, removed Encounter.diagnosis.rank from active Encounter source, moved billing-diagnosis ranking guidance to Account, and introduced the current Encounter Diagnosis Use binding. FHIR-38784 then explicitly changed Encounter.diagnosis.use and Encounter.reason.use to 0..* and is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-38807 is also already represented and corrected remaining Encounter reason/diagnosis wording while preserving the later repeating cardinalities.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. Encounter is active and approved in source/fhir.ini, and source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml already has Encounter.diagnosis max="*" and Encounter.diagnosis.use max="*" with a preferred binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/encounter-diagnosis-use.
